subject.title: [Feature]: Auto-discovery of agent configurations from external workspaces

question: Should OpenClaw add core trusted external workspace-agent discovery, or keep agent registration explicit and improve explicit runtime registration/hot-load instead?
rationale: The request adds a new config option, filesystem scanning, trust boundaries, and live routing/session semantics that source inspection cannot safely choose for maintainers.

options.title: Keep Explicit Registration
options.body: Continue using central config, `$include`, and `agents.create/update/delete`, and treat workspace auto-discovery as operator tooling unless a smaller missing API is identified.

options.title: Design Trusted Discovery
options.body: Approve a core discovery contract only after maintainers define trusted roots, precedence, validation, reload behavior, and security proof.

options.title: Prioritize Zero-Restart Management
options.body: Defer glob discovery and first design hot-load/hot-remove semantics for explicit agent registration, matching the main pain called out in discussion.

recommendation.title: Keep Explicit Registration
recommendation.body: Continue using central config, `$include`, and `agents.create/update/delete`, and treat workspace auto-discovery as operator tooling unless a smaller missing API is identified.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest combined feature-history signal for multi-agent routing and central gateway agent management.
